records.name: FancyBubbles
records.tagline: Turn LinkedIn to a Personal website in seconds
records.description: FancyBubbles instantly converts your LinkedIn profile into a beautiful, SEO-optimized personal website — no coding needed. Just connect your LinkedIn, and your site is live in seconds. Perfect for professionals, freelancers, and consultants who want a powerful online presence without the hassle.

records.name: Path: Precision Timeline
records.tagline: Private on-device timeline for places and routes
records.description: Path turns your iPhone into a private timeline of the places you visit, the routes you take, your steps, and the photos attached to those days. It records passively, processes everything locally on device, and requires no account or central server. I built it after years of relying on Moves and Arc Timeline apps, then losing trust when the product I paid for stopped working. Path is for people who want memory, context, and ownership of their location history.

records.name: KitnaBana
records.tagline: Ghanto Ka Hisab Ab Minto me!
records.description: KitnaBana app helps gig workers track daily earnings, expenses & savings. Voice-based entry in Hindi/Hinglish. AI-powered insights for Rapido, Uber, Ola, Swiggy, Zomato riders. Free forever. Download now!

records.name: AI-powered Intercompany Elimination
records.tagline: Close faster. Sign off smarter.
records.description: Financial close teams spend 3–5 days on intercompany matching, eliminations, and approvals. Close Command changes that. AI computes matching and elimination entries across 28 rule types — then stops. Every journal entry requires a named human reviewer before posting. Timestamped. Audit-ready. No exceptions. 60–70% less manual reconciliation. Up to 2 days recovered per close cycle. → 28 elimination rule types → Human-in-the-loop hard gate → Audit trail + Excel export → Multi-currency support

records.name: Shifa Siddiqui Portfolio
records.tagline: UI/UX Designer for Web & Mobile Apps
records.description: Portfolio of Shifa Siddiqui, a Product Designer with a Biotechnology background, now focused on UI/UX. I create clean, simple, and user-friendly digital products for web and mobile, from logos to full experiences. This portfolio showcases real projects, design thinking, and solutions built to improve usability and solve real user problems. I’ve worked on CacheVector’s brand and platform, along with multiple projects. Open to freelance and collaborations.

records.name: SRTGen.com
records.tagline: Professional AI Subtitles for Your Viral Videos
records.description: We’re SRTGen.com — a professional AI subtitle generator & editor built to make beautiful animated subtitles fast, affordable, and effortless. X Integration Mention @SRTGenDotCom on any post on X, and we’ll subtitle or translate the video directly for you. SRTGen is perfect for creators, clips, podcasts, interviews, tutorials, and short-form content. ✅ Powerful & Easy-to-Use Subtitle Editor ✅ Accurate Word-Level Precision ✅ Affordable Pricing — One of the Cheapest on the Market

records.name: Learn Cloud Engineering Online in Dubai
records.tagline: Cloud Certification Course – DXB Cloud Academy
records.description: DXB Cloud Academy is a premium online learning platform based in Dubai, UAE. It offers expert-led courses in Cloud Computing, Full Stack Web Development, IT & Computer Science, and Corporate Training. With 250+ courses, certified professional tutors, and lifetime access, learners can study at their own pace. The academy provides joint India–Dubai recognized certifications trusted by top companies like Microsoft, Amazon, and Google.

records.name: SWACN
records.tagline: Don't just watch the recording. Walk inside it.
records.description: SWACN is a tool that turns terminal recordings into interactive, bootable sandboxes. If you’ve ever used asciinema, you know it’s great for watching a CLI tool in action. SWACN takes that a step further: it captures your terminal session and its filesystem into a tiny, client-side Linux VM (running in WASM). Your audience doesn't just watch a video; they can "flip" the recording and actually use the tool themselves right there in the browser.

records.name: Snap A Meal™
records.tagline: A radically new way to build food awareness
records.description: Snap A Meal gives you the opportunity to eat better, to eat healthier, and to be more aware of what you eat each day, thanks to its powerful and advanced algorithm and its process for each food you log. You will also have access to all the history of everything you eat and drink for the entire time you have been using Snap A Meal. Everything is synced in the cloud, and you can access all of your food diary from any device thanks to Snap A Meal.

records.name: Notion 3.4
records.tagline: New dashboards, connectors, sidebar & smarter AI agents
records.description: Notion now generates images, builds dashboards, and presents your docs without leaving the workspace. 10+ features shipped for operators, PMs, and teams scaling on AI.

records.name: Gravity Simulator
records.tagline: Interactive Space Physics Sandbox In Your Browser
records.description: Explore gravity through two interactive physics engines built for experimentation and learning. Test how objects fall on different planets and moons with the Object Drop Engine, or create realistic orbital simulations featuring planetary motion, collisions, slingshots, and N-body gravity systems. Gravity Simulator runs entirely in the browser with real-time controls, cinematic visuals, and scientifically inspired physics - no downloads or installations required.

records.name: AI Cat Tools, Games & Free Generators.
records.tagline: Free cat tools and games. Built with love, judged by cats.
records.description: Free AI-powered tools for cat lovers. Advice, horoscopes, passwords, name quizzes, love compatibility and more. No signup, completely free.

records.name: Recall
records.tagline: Track your revision, study with flashcards and ace your exam
records.description: Recall helps students stop forgetting what they revise. Add subjects and chapters, log study sessions and past papers, and get automatic spaced repetition reminders for what to review next. Built from my own struggle with chemistry revision, it keeps track of weak topics, flashcards, scores, and progress so students can study with less guesswork.

records.name: FlyTradr
records.tagline: Trade Smarter
records.description: FlyTradr is a no code platform that helps retail traders build, backtest, validate, and automate trading strategies. Instead of writing scripts or relying on spreadsheets, traders can turn their ideas into structured trading systems, test them on historical data, review performance and risk metrics, and prepare them for automation. The mission is to democratize algo trading and make it more accessible to retail traders.

records.name: JigsawReveal
records.tagline: Hide secret messages inside custom digital jigsaw puzzles.
records.description: Create beautiful, shareable puzzle reveals.Turn any photo into a custom digital jigsaw puzzle with a hidden surprise. I built this to help people send secret messages and photos in a way that’s more interactive than a simple text. Recipients solve the puzzle to unlock custom reveal animations—ranging from fireworks and confetti to romantic rose petals. Perfect for long-distance surprises, birthdays, or just making a friend work for a meme.

records.name: Buddzy
records.tagline: Friendships, not followers; we turn real bonds into a game.
records.description: Buddzy is built on one conviction: friendship should be the point of social, not the byproduct. The friendship becomes a game, not an audience. No followers, no public feed, no DMs. A five-pillar social game that makes relationships feel like a daily adventure. Viral by design, safe by architecture.

records.name: PistonJob
records.tagline: Focus on Interviews, Not Forms
records.description: Stop manually searching for your next gig. PistonJob automates the grind of job hunting and lead generation. We act as your personal engine, filtering the noise and delivering highly relevant, curated opportunities directly to you. Put your lead gen on autopilot so you can focus your energy on what actually matters: landing the job and doing great work.
